_readme: Pending merge into content/universe.json (19 Nov 2026, Site File decision; rules in docs/SITE-FILE.md). Merge: add 'series_entry' as series['site-file'] and append 'items' to items in place (no re-sort, indent 1), run tools/check_universe.py, commit, then delete this file.

series_entry.name: Site File
series_entry.format: reel, 45-90 s: a monument (how it was built, what it looked like) or an excavation (from the published report: trench, layers, finds, the people who lived there); stills animated in code plus 2-4 generated video clips
series_entry.note: Decided 19 Nov 2026 (Pryank). Weekly, Sun 13:00 IST, test until 3 Jan 2027 (docs/SITE-FILE.md). Visuals are AI-made, so Meta's AI label is ON and YouTube's altered-or-synthetic flag is Yes; scheduled in Meta's own planner, not through Make. On-screen tags: Excavated, Reconstructed, Debated. Excavation topics may invite archaeologywala as Collab. Monuments and excavations as AI video are Talaash's; archaeologywala's story reels keep 14 days clear of any Site File topic (the 30-day topic lock still applies across both accounts).

items.title: Site File #1: Burzahom, life in a pit house
items.sources: Primary: ASI, Burzahom (1960-1971) excavation report (asi.nic.in/pdf/Burzahom-Excavation-Report-compressed.pdf); edition and pages to be recorded by the Site File desk
items.notes: Excavation. Demand: en.wikipedia 'Burzahom archaeological site' about 10,800 views Nov 2025-Oct 2026; no Instagram reel found in a site search on 19 Nov 2026. Neolithic only; no present-day political framing. Collab invite to archaeologywala (accepted in the app).

items.title: Site File #2: Bhitargaon, a temple built of brick
items.sources: To be found and read by the Site File desk: ASI reports and standard architectural surveys of the Bhitargaon temple; edition and pages required
items.notes: Monument. Demand about 15,000 views in 12 months; about 15 reels in a 20-result search, none of them on how the brick shell and arch were built (19 Nov check). No deity figure; terracotta panels only as plain shapes unless documented.

items.title: Site File #3: Inamgaon, a farming village on the Ghod
items.sources: Dhavalikar, Sankalia and Ansari (eds), Excavations at Inamgaon I (Pune: Deccan College, 1988); the desk must read the cited pages before use
items.notes: Excavation, Pune audience. Demand about 5,100 views in 12 months plus UPSC question demand; about 5 relevant reels. If the report pages cannot be read by D-12, swap with #4 and report it.

items.title: Site File #4: Kanheri, how a hill was made to hold water
items.sources: To be fixed by the desk from ASI and peer-reviewed studies of the Kanheri water system; edition and pages required
items.notes: Monument, Mumbai audience. Demand about 34,000 views in 12 months; reels are mostly visits, one reel on the water system in a 20-result search (19 Nov check). No Buddha or bodhisattva figure; plain labelled shapes.

items.title: Site File #5: Kalibangan, the ploughed field
items.sources: Lal, Joshi, Thapar and Bala, Excavations at Kalibangan: The Early Harappans (1960-1969), MASI 98, ASI 2003 (downloadable from asi.nic.in)
items.notes: Excavation. Demand about 36,000 views in 12 months plus a frequent exam question; about 2 reels on the field itself. Kept 30+ days clear of archaeologywala's Harappan diorama (5 Dec). Report facts only; no present-day continuity claims beyond what the report states.
